name: search-hole
description: A local search gateway for AI assistants: choose the engines and sites your AI searches, see every search, get source receipts.

brave_api_key.title: Brave Search API key (optional)
brave_api_key.description: Optional extra engine. Brave gives $5 of free credit per month (about 1,000 searches) but asks for a card and an attribution link; sign up at https://brave.com/search/api/. Leave empty to skip.

tavily_api_key.title: Tavily API key (optional)
tavily_api_key.description: Optional extra engine with the easiest free tier: 1,000 searches per month, no credit card. Sign up at https://app.tavily.com and paste the key. Leave empty to skip.

search_mode.title: Search mode
search_mode.description: auto (default): use your engines when one is healthy, otherwise filter Claude's built-in WebSearch. builtin: always filter the built-in WebSearch. engines: always route searches through search-hole's engines. Values: auto, builtin, engines.
